title: wargame_utils terminology (wgu/terms@1)
description: Concept-based glossary. The unit is a CONCEPT in a context (level + scope), not an English word: one source word may map to several concepts with different Polish equivalents. Layers: common (all wargames) < era < series < game (edition). The most specific layer wins; overriding an upper-layer concept must be explicit (`overrides`).

source.description: short source id from references/zrodla.md (e.g. GMT-SPQR-PL3, WSJP, AAP6-2005PL) or a full citation

form.description: the form attested in the source (short)

supports.description: what the evidence shows: a word existing in Polish (existence) is NOT proof that it is the right equivalent of the game concept

source_term.description: canonical source-language term as printed in the rules

variants.description: inflections, abbreviations, spellings in the source (Routed, routs, MA)

sense.description: definition / description of the mechanic in own words (disambiguates homonyms)

disambiguation.description: how to recognise THIS sense in the source text when the word has other senses

rules.description: rule ids/numbers where the concept is defined or used

pl_forms.description: allowed inflected forms (used for consistency checks); may include multi-word forms

first_use.description: e.g. 'ucieczka\ang{rout}' — bilingual on first use in a section

component_text.description: text printed on counters/charts — keep as printed or translate? state it

overrides.description: id of an upper-layer concept this record replaces in this scope

related.description: ids of concepts easily confused with this one

decided_by.description: user = owner's editorial decision; analyst = based on evidence, awaiting owner; imported = taken over from an existing approved table

preference.description: true = owner's editorial preference (not a dictionary finding)

history.description: previous equivalents — `wgu terms impact` searches them to find passages needing update
